how_to_reserve.title: How to Reserve in The Watch Collections?

1.title: Choose Your Timepiece
1.description: Browse our curated selection and pick the watch you’d like to reserve.

2.title: Submit Your Reservation Request
2.description: Share your details and preferred timeframe so we can securely hold the watch for you.

3.title: Receive Confirmation
3.description: We’ll verify availability, confirm your reservation, and outline inspection and payment options.

4.title: Secure Payment & Delivery
4.description: Complete payment and choose insured shipping or in-person handover for your reserved watch.
